FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 103
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 103 as introduced could impact the financial obligations of state and local
governments engaging in certain public work contracts by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the method of public notice chosen, pursuant to the provisions of this bill, for sealed bid
contracts.
